svg.aria-label: Classic Loader: radial construction, bar detail, opacity cycle, size family and source variable tables

g.text: SCALE 18:1 AT MD · ENLARGED SOURCE VIEWBOX
AXES AND CIRCLES ARE CONSTRUCTION GUIDES.
ONLY THE TWELVE PILLS ARE PAINTED.
Z1 IS THE CSS BOX; U IS THE SVG VIEWBOX.

svg.text: TWELVE IDENTICAL SVG PILLS; ROTATE ABOUT C.
THE ROOT AND INNER SVG HAVE NO PAINTED FRAME.
ONLY OPACITY ANIMATES; THE GEOMETRY IS FIXED.
NEGATIVE DELAYS SHOW A COMPLETE TRAIL AT MOUNT.
SIZE UTILITIES MAY OVERRIDE THE SIZE FAMILY.
BAR INK INHERITS CURRENTCOLOR FROM THE CALLER.
LOADING = FALSE REMOVES THE ENTIRE ROOT.
NO RESERVED BOX OR STATUS REMAINS.
LABEL SUPPLIES THE ACCESSIBLE STATUS NAME.
WITHOUT LABEL, THE ROOT IS DECORATIVE.
REDUCED MOTION KEEPS THE LOOP DURATION.
THE INDICATOR DOES NOT COLLAPSE TO A STROBE.
SCALE 8:1 AT MD · NO SHADOW / NO BORDER
CLEARANCE IS INTERNAL; EXTERNAL GAP = S2 [TBD].
NEIGHBOUR PHASE GAP: Δ = T / N.
AFTER Δ, THE NEXT BAR RESETS TO α0.
LINEAR FADE THEN INSTANT RESET · PHASE OF BAR i
αi(t) = α0 − (α0 − α1) · frac((t − Δi) / T)
NO SHADOW, SCRIM OR INTERACTIVE HIT TARGET.
